# BeeWorks Asset Directory

Drop your official `logo.svg` or `logo.png` file in this folder:

- `/public/assets/logo.svg` (Official Vector Logo)
- `/public/assets/logo.png` (PNG alternative if needed)

The `<Logo />` component (`src/components/common/Logo.tsx`) will automatically render `logo.svg` with dark/light variants and size configurations across all headers, sidebars, navigation bars, and authentication screens.
